data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Square In-App Payments SDK to take payments on iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: Wraps Square's native Android and iOS In-App Payments SDKs, allowing mobile apps to take in-app payments, support Apple Pay, Google Pay, and perform buyer verification.
use_when: You need to accept payments in your app using Square.
You need Apple Pay or Google Pay integration powered by Square.
avoid_when: You need to issue refunds directly inside the mobile app.
You are using a payment gateway other than Square.
strengths: Official Square wrapper supporting native Android and iOS SDKs.
Supports Apple Pay and Google Pay buyer verification flows.
weaknesses: Cannot issue refunds directly; requires the Refunds API or Square Dashboard.
Specific native SDK version and build requirements (e.g., iOS 17.1+, Android API 28+).
data.setup_notes: Requires native configuration for Android (minSdkVersion 28, targetSdkVersion 36) and iOS (Swift Package Manager, deployment target iOS 17.1+), plus configuring a backend to process nonces.

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you want to use Stripe as your payment gateway instead of Square.

alternatives.name: adyen_checkout
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you want to use Adyen as your payment gateway instead of Square.
